guides.title: CBP rule: a foreign importer of record must use CTPAT validation or a CTPAT-validated licensed customs broker (FR 2026-22735, effective 2027-01-05)
guides.description: From 2027-01-05 a foreign IOR must be CTPAT-validated or use a CTPAT-validated licensed customs broker, and a U.S. IOR declares its status on each entry. Key dates, who is affected, the options, and what the rule text does not answer.

key_dates.event: Published in the Federal Register (91 FR 69977-70007; FR Doc. 2026-22735; docket USCBP-2026-1387; CBP Dec. 26-19)
Rule effective. From this date the updated CBP Forms 3461 and 7501 must be used for each entry and entry summary
A licensed customs broker may request delayed compliance with the new verification duty in 19 CFR 111.29
All brokers expected to be fully compliant

authorities.citation: Heightened Requirements for Foreign Importers of Record, interim final rule with request for comments, 91 FR 69977-70007 (Nov. 6, 2026), FR Doc. 2026-22735, docket USCBP-2026-1387, CBP Dec. 26-19, RIN 1685-AA48
19 CFR 24.36 — refunds paid to the importer of record

guides.reading_note: The rule was read on 2026-11-13 against the Federal Register full text, obtained from the Federal Register website on 2026-11-10 (URL above); 19 CFR 24.36 was read on 2026-11-14. Rules change; check the current text before relying on any date stated here.

guides.title: IEEPA duty refunds: CAPE or the CIT
guides.description: Two routes for IEEPA duty refunds: a CAPE declaration in ACE, or a protest and then the CIT. Who receives the refund, the key dates, the periods that may apply, and what to gather.

key_dates.event: Supreme Court: IEEPA does not authorize the President to impose tariffs (Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump, No. 24-1287)
CBP stopped collecting IEEPA duties on goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption from 12:00 a.m. ET
The CIT certified a class (Freestyle World, Inc. v. CBP, No. 26-01088)

guides.title: Exporting to the EU? Three rules your EU buyers will ask you about before 30 December 2026
guides.description: The EU deforestation regulation applies to large and medium operators from 30 December 2026, the green-claims ban has applied since 27 September 2026, and the packaging regulation since 12 August 2026. What each one means for a Chinese factory or seller supplying the EU, what the EU buyer will ask for, and what to prepare.

guides.title: Received a CBP Form 28 (CF-28)? What to Do Next
guides.description: A CBP Form 28 is a Request for Information about specific import entries. What it means, what to identify before you answer, which dates matter, what to keep, and when a broker or an attorney fits.

authorities.citation: CBP Form 28, Request for Information (08/24): preprinted questions A–B and items A–E, the CBP Officer Message box, the Certification block (signer: owner, importer, or corporate/company official; not required if a foreign firm completes the form), and General Information and Instructions items 1–6
